measurement_object_recommendation.target: graph-batch cost under an explicit conditioned execution recipe
measurement_object_recommendation.basis: existing Graph Replay and ten-warmup scope; not full-plan or post-idle latency
measurement_object_recommendation.anchor_purpose: compare explicitly matched pre/post execution conditions
measurement_object_recommendation.resume_or_first_launch_cost: separate condition and contract if required; never mix with conditioned labels

design.question: does one explicit conditioning replay reduce the observed first-position contrast under this recipe?
design.only_intervention: presence of exactly one conditioning replay before each measured endpoint triple

shared_recipe.fresh_uuid_and_build: observe at collection and require the same signature across four cells; no substitution by model name
shared_recipe.round_order: pre conditioning(0/1) -> three measured pre -> one target -> post conditioning(0/1) -> three measured post
shared_recipe.fixture: data/ffn_measurement_b3/recipe.json; existing Down0 fixtures and buffers
shared_recipe.reset_sync_validation: existing order and byte/numerical checks, outside each Event interval
shared_recipe.conditioning_record: separate named stage with boundaries/checks/diagnostic time; not a dropped measured sample
shared_recipe.conditioning_to_first_sample: no disk I/O, telemetry or profiler between completion and first measured replay; record actual gap
shared_recipe.telemetry: before pre conditioning and after post measurements; missing remains null plus error
shared_recipe.trace: after all timing; no later timing
shared_recipe.quality_diagnostics: same 10% endpoint IQR/median, median drift and target IQR rules; no relaxation

planned_counts.excludes: initialization, capture, ten warmups per graph and post-timing trace

readouts.endpoint: all three values; first minus median(next two), absolute and relative; original triple IQR and pre/post drift
readouts.primary_per_run: median of the seven pre first-minus-next-two contrasts; preserve every endpoint and separately show post
readouts.two_block_contrasts: B minus A within block1 and block2; display both signs, no hidden pooling
readouts.target: all seven durations and IQR/median, to observe any changed target condition
readouts.pipeline_pass: all four complete with correct numeric/path/identity/boundary records
readouts.limited_replication: two ordered blocks are descriptive engineering evidence, not validated rate or bias estimates
readouts.mechanism: conditioning also changes preceding GPU work, cache/state and host history; mechanism remains unresolved
